notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
